title: intentional sound and intentional silence; a silent deliverable is not a generation failure

events.what: the word is spoken and highlighted

audio_cues.break_reason: the turn lands on the one sound

motif.description: a soft glass tap returns on each reveal

silence_windows.why: let the room go quiet before the turn

expect.direction: validateDirection ok; sfx role causal (default, in defaults_applied); every_visual_hit false; palette 2 ingredients
expect.cue_in_silence: cue-land-in-silence warns cue-in-silence; cue-deliberate does not (breaks_silence with a reason); cue-open is outside the window
expect.autofill: dropInSilence on candidate {id:'x', t:3.5} drops it with why 'inside the protected pre_payoff silence window'
expect.no_universal_cue: e-land has no authored cue and the seam sound is legacy: nothing is added to 'cover' every visual hit

direction.silent_reason: a quiet launch loop on a lobby screen

silent_deliverable.failure_variant: direction with_audio, audio_files [], generation {attempted:true, errors:['tts timeout']} -> generation_failed, complete false

expect.no_sfx_check: sfxExpectation(role none) -> required false with silent_by_choice, so sound.mjs check does not raise no-sfx
